SELECT id, operation_type, operation_business, operation_object, user_name, user_id, remark, create_time, menu_id FROM bp_operation_log WHERE is_deleted = 0
and operation_type = #{operationType}
and menu_id like concat(#{menuId},'%')
and (user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%') or login_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%'))
and create_time between concat(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00') and concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by create_time desc
